title: Nonlinear Stability of Subextremal Kerr Black Holes
exact_target: Do all sufficiently small perturbations of a nonextremal rotating vacuum black hole settle to another Kerr black hole?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002077 (OWR-11788-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Nonlinear Evolution Problems (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/26, pp. 1563--1637. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 11, 12.

status_qualification: The catalogue does not specify the perturbation norm, gauge or convergence topology. Those are parts of the stability formulation in the cited report; the target is the full subextremal family, rather than a silently restricted small-rotation theorem.
